THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TI: Your constructs are impressive. I like mine better.
Let's put that to the test.
NEOW.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_CH: A builder... how curious. Your machines carry a strange warmth.
Warmth is just energy transfer. Nothing strange about it.
Back again, Tinkerer. Your bots remember this place, even if you do not.
And they'll keep turning until I get it right.
DARV.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_CH: Ah, a fellow artisan! Your hands tell the story — grease, solder, ambition.
You can read all that from hands?
I can read a lot of things, machinist. Especially price tags.
The Tinkerer returns! I've been saving some rare components for you.
You know, that nickname is growing on me.
VAKUU.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_C: The silence here... it's like a vacuum. No vibrations for the bots to pick up.
Vakuu consumes. Even sound. Even purpose.
The machine-maker returns to the void.
Your creations cannot fill this emptiness.
TEZCATARA.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKER: Look into the glass, builder. Do you see yourself, or your machines?
I see... schematics. Blueprints reflected in the surface.
Interesting. Most see fears. You see potential.
The mirror remembers your reflection, Tinkerer.
Again you peer into the glass.
TANX.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_CH: Hah! A tinkerer! You look like you could fix my plumbing.
I build war machines, not... actually, how complex is the plumbing?
The mechanic returns! Still got oil under your nails, I see.
Back for more supplies, grease monkey?
PAEL.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_CH: A creator visits a creator. But your art moves on gears instead of canvas.
Engineering is art. Just with more moving parts.
The artisan returns. I've painted something for your bots.
Show me what you've built since last we met.
Gladly. Every version is an improvement.
OROBAS.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKERER_: A mortal who builds servants of metal. How... industrious.
They're companions, not servants. There's a difference.
Is there? They obey your every command, do they not?
The builder returns. Have your machines taught you anything about power?
Still tinkering with toys, I see.
These 'toys' hit harder than you'd expect.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETINKERERMOD-THE_TINKER: Oh! Your little machines — they hum! What a delightful frequency!
That's just the servos. They're not supposed to make that noise, actually.
Imperfection is the soul of music, dear builder!
The humming one returns! Your bots have a new tune today.
...they don't do that. But I appreciate the enthusiasm.
